fnol_text: My name is Hannah Chukwu and I live at 605 Sycamore Drive, Clinton, NC 28310. You can reach me on (555) 546-9583 or hannah.chukwu@example.com. There was a flood warning for our area from the day before, but I left the car parked on the street by the river. On 29 December 2024 the water rose and the car was flooded up to the seats. Policy MT-2023-00089. I'd like to claim for the damage to my car. Please just tell me this is covered.

adjuster_notes.text: Called Dr Chukwu on (555) 546-9583 to acknowledge the claim. Hannah confirmed the loss date as 29 December 2024.
Vehicle inspected at the repairer. Witness Mateo Haddad gave a statement by phone.
Hannah sent photos and a contractor's estimate. Water line visible on walls.
